errors.evidence: Description incorrectly states that the sector 'никога' is yellow and shows 57.1%, when it is actually orange. The sector 'по-малко от 10' is incorrectly stated as grey with 26.2%, but it is actually grey. The descriptions for 'между 10 и 20' and '20 или повече' are also reversed.
Description states that the sector 'между 10 и 20' is approximately 12%, but it visually occupies a larger proportion of the pie chart than indicated.
Description states that the sector '20 или повече' is approximately 5%, but it visually occupies a larger area than stated.
The description omits to mention that the yellow sector 'никога' visually represents close to 0% in the pie chart, disregarding its labeled percentage.
Phrasing such as 'визуално заема приблизително около 12%' lacks clarity in how close the visual representation is to the actual values.
